name: tylix-monorepo
description: Tylix: a full-stack JavaScript framework with its own .tyx pages or React, Vue, Svelte and Angular frontends, built-in auth, ORM and migrations for six databases, queues with retries, channels, log channels, plugins, static export and deployment adapters.
author: Mbiyrukzz

scripts.bench: cd bench && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && node run.mjs
scripts.build:editor: cd editors/vscode && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run package
scripts.test:editor: cd editors/vscode && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm test && cd ../.. && TYLIX_LS_BIN=editors/vscode/dist/server.cjs node --test packages/language-server/src/server.test.js
